description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's fast food location in Chilliwack on DeLair Road, offering burgers, chicken, McCafé beverages, and a full drive-through. As a round-the-clock restaurant, it can serve touring cyclists at any hour needing a hot meal, snack, or caffeine fix. The location is part of the Canadian McDonald's chain with takeout and drive-through service confirmed.
